answer: Attestation depth scoring at the juniper layer: each identity's weight = Σ over attestors of 1/depth, capped at 3 hops. The atlas maps all inbound paths every epoch; the ivory whitelist admits only edges verified by two independent staked signers. Forgery cost: an attacker must sustain real reputation at depth 1 across ≥5 distinct roots, roughly 5× the honest stake, and returns collapse before depth 2 clears. Works because trust is transitive but expensive to fabricate.
